Ryan Cho: Hey folks — Ryan here, starting today on Eng Platform (PST). Quick Qs: who do I ping for SSH/VPN and MDM? Also what's the recommended keyboard layout? Any office snack recs?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Ryan!! :tada: Buddy = Sam W. We'll send the onboarding schedule and swag form (https://redwood.company/swag-form). Any dietary needs?

Sam Wells: Hey Ryan 44b For VPN/SSH open the IT portal: https://it.redwood/portal and attach your public key. If you want, DM me the key and I'll paste it for you. We'll also add you to the eng-platform groups.

IT-Bot: Ticket #IT-8055 opened: "Onboard Ryan Cho - VPN/SSH/MDM". ETA 1 business day.

Nina (DevEx): For keyboard: most of us use the compact TKL layout with `karabiner` presets. Clone our dotfiles: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/dotfiles.git && ./install.sh`. Use `--minimal` if you want just terminal + zsh.

Theo (Platform): If you'll be in SF, ping @hannah for office snacks — we usually have oat milk + granola. Also coffee club Wed 3pm.

Hannah (Ops): Snacks: espresso machine + cold brew in the kitchen. Also vegan bars in the left shelf. Welcome!

Ryan Cho: Thanks all 60a I'll open the portal ticket and DM Sam my public key. No dietary restrictions. Small fun fact: I collect vintage arcade pins. Looking forward to meeting you all!

Maya (People Ops): Noted, welcome aboard again :balloon: We'll ship the welcome box early next week.
